fact: Lands Minister Hamat Bah said on 4 September 2026 that the government is developing a Land Information System to digitise records of landholdings, with World Bank-supported consultants working on it and a draft expected by end-September 2026.
Dr Samba Sowe of the Land Policy Implementation Unit said the alpha version of the National Land Information System is complete and in testing before full rollout.

The Standard reports the Ministry of Lands' Director of Planning said a contracted company is developing a digital land registry and online land information system, due in 2027, with testing scheduled to begin the next May.
system: Digital land registry / online land information system

fact: Minister Hamat Bah said a tender for the National Land Information System attracted nine firms, with evaluation and contract signing expected in early 2026.
